name: Data quality tasks reconciliation and external assumptions
description: Verify data confidence, workbook comparison, reconciliation, task workflow, evidence, and assumption review.

planSteps.description: Decision confidence, top blocking issues, workbook A/B difference, dashboard reconciliation, issue distribution, open tasks, and evidence trail are visible
Create a manual task titled TESTSPRITE TEMP TASK, move it to in progress, then complete it with a completion note
The task status changes are saved and auditable without duplicate task creation
Open Dış varsayımlar and create a user-sourced interest assumption named TESTSPRITE TEMP ASSUMPTION with a current date and small value
The assumption appears with its source, date, type, and review state
Approve the TESTSPRITE TEMP ASSUMPTION using the review control
The record moves to approved and appears among approved assumptions without changing source financial facts
